title: henckelia craspedodroma

It is native to the tropical forests of Borneo, where it is highly valued for its medicinal and therapeutic properties. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits which include antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Henckelia craspedodroma include expectorant, analgesic, and antipyretic effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids.
